abilities.name: Despite My Wounds
abilities.description: While you have two or more moderate wounds or one major wound, you get a free reroll on one action each round (as if you had spent 1 XP). Enabler.

abilities.name: Enhanced Scavenging
abilities.description: When you roll to scavenge the postapocalyptic landscape for something useful and your roll is less than a 9, treat the roll as a 9. (This means you don’t get a GM intrusion if you roll a 1.) Your enhanced effect persists until you take a ten-minute or longer recovery.

abilities.name: Effort
abilities.description: Increase the minimum number rolled for this ability by 3.

abilities.name: Get Out
abilities.description: If you move at least an immediate distance away from the most obvious threat or toward what promises to offer safety, one task you attempt next round is eased. Enabler.
